summary: Retested requested users/dashboard permission fixes on preview URL. Backend regression for /api/users and /api/users/{id} update behavior passed (4/4). Frontend flows passed for فرج1 dashboard access, blocked operations access, hidden New Vehicle action, and updated /users cards/badges visibility.
action_items: Optional hardening: current session cookie is client-written via document.cookie (not HttpOnly). If security requirements apply, migrate to server-set HttpOnly cookie flow.
Provide /app/auth_testing.md or update playbook path; optional auth playbook checks could not be executed from the requested location.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to include فرج1 and مدير entries together for deterministic auth retests.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx is very large (~980 lines), increasing regression risk and making permission/UI fixes harder to isolate and verify.
Login/session flow stores auth session in localStorage + JS-readable cookie; this does not satisfy HttpOnly cookie control from auth best practices.
seed_data_creation: Created two temporary TEST_ users via API during regression and deleted them in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://canonical-integrity.preview.emergentagent.com: فرج1 login redirects to / and dashboard stat cards render (no stuck initial loader), /operations direct route redirects away for فرج1, and استقبال مركبة button is hidden. Admin /users shows 4 cards including label 'اسم الدخول: فرج1' and permission badges صفحة العمليات/دفتر اليومية/الأرشيف. Backend tests confirm /api/users includes username, strips password, contains normalized modules, and PUT non-permission update preserves existing permissions.
rca of the issue: Previously reported behavior likely stemmed from stale/partial session permissions and inconsistent username handling. Current implementation now refreshes session permissions from /api/users and normalizes username fallback in backend routes, which removed dashboard loading/routing mismatch for فرج1 and restored users page expected labels/modules.
test_credentials: File /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but currently lists only مدير; فرج1 credential had to be taken from review request.
